Event

Casino on Yacht

Explore and gamble to your heart's content with your teammates on a luxury Yacht, uncovering the true face of Nyar!

Activity TypeGveCruiseCasinoPhases3Duration7 or 8 days

Across all phases

Core Rewards

NyarFellow · NyarSylthielFamily · SylthielMagellanFellow · MagellanCostume [Advent] (★5)Fellow Costume · Nyar
GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
Gameplay

◆ During the Casino on Yacht event, you can team up to explore and complete challenges.

◆ The goal is to explore the Yacht ship and get as many treasures as possible!

Team Rules

◆ During the team formation phase, you can create, join, leave, or disband teams.

◆ Creating a team is free the first time, but subsequent creations require crystals.

Yacht Exploration

◆ Exploring misty zones consumes Stamina. Exploration progress is shared by the team.

◆ Stamina regenerates over time but stops once it reaches the limit. You can also consume a Deluxe Chicken Meal or Chicken Meal to restore it.

◆ Exploring misty zones earns points and may uncover Gamblers, lost items, or other special incidents in the Yacht.

◆ Accumulate points to collect rewards in Exploration Rewards and the Yacht Pass.

◆ The entrance to the next stage is hidden around the Yacht ship dungeon. Once found, team members must collaborate to harness Nyar's Magic to open the entrance.

Nyar's Magic

◆ The Nyar's Magic for each level is located somewhere on the ground. You must move toward it and consume Stamina to capture it.

◆ After each attempt at capturing Nyar's Magic, it will escape into the mist until its flight chances reach 0.

◆ Capturing Nyar's Magic will unlock the entrance to the next level.

Gambler Challenges

◆ Your destructive power is equal to the sum of your Fellows' Total Power.

◆ You can find various types of Gamblers while exploring. Gamblers can only be defeated when your Power is superior to theirs.

◆ Upon victory, you and all team members will receive the corresponding rewards.

◆ You can also use Wild Cards or X-Ray Cards collected during exploration to influence the gambler's combat power.

◆ The effect of Wild Cards or X-Ray Cards on ordinary gamblers and the Vault Guard differs in terms of power reduction.

◆ An X-Ray Card requires X-Ray Glasses to be picked up and used. It can also be shared with other teammates.

Vault Guard

◆ The Vault Guard is a Gambler guarding the treasure vault on each stage. It must be defeated to enter the vault.

◆ Unlike ordinary gamblers, if the combat power is insufficient, you can choose to share with teammates. Other teammates may also use Wild Cards or X-Ray Cards on the Vault Guard.

Vault

◆ The vault holds several treasures, reserved as rewards for Transcenders who successfully defeat the Vault Guard.

◆ Every member of a team can enter the vault and claim 4 pieces of treasure—there's no need to fight over the loot!

◆ Among the treasures, there is a hidden grand prize in each vault. Who will be the lucky member of the team this time?!

Yacht Map

◆ After unlocking the entrance to a lower level, all team members can descend and return to previous levels at any time.

◆ The Casino on Yacht has five zones: Ballroom, Bar, Restaurant, Deck, and Casino. Each zone has 5 levels, totaling 25 levels.

◆ The points gained from each zone are consistent, but the types of Gambles, their Power, and the rewards for defeating them increases as you reach higher levels.

◆ Rumor has it that beyond the Casino's last level lies the wondrous Endless Casino, ready for infinite challenges.

Lost Cargo

◆ The clumsy Chubby Ginger lost some cargo in the yatch. You can help him find it while exploring.

◆ When the cargo has been found, Chubby Ginger will reward you and offer valuable goods at a discount. All team members can purchase them.

Leaderboards and Rewards

◆ The rankings in the Casino on Yacht event are divided into overall rankings and daily rankings.

◆ The daily rankings refresh every day and are based on both personal points and team points.

◆ Yacht scores are calculated based on the number of wild cards and X-Ray cards used, with 1 Wild Card worth 10 points and 1 X-Ray Card worth 20 points.

◆ The overall leaderboards are settled at the end of the event, and are based on personal points and the highest team level reached.

◆ After the leaderboards have been calculated, rewards can be claimed based on ranks.

◆ Unclaimed ranking rewards will be sent to you via mail.

Vault Chest Probabilities

◆ Normal Chest: 93.75%

◆ Superchest: 6.25%
